title: Round-number crossing continuation (Osler 2003), one validation test
status: PENDING OPERATOR APPROVAL - drafted 2026-11-01; the validation partition has NOT been read
source_of_hypothesis: Phase B4 on development data (research/results/b4_development_2026-11-01.json, trial '15min RN_CROSS_100 T15'); mechanism: stop-loss orders cluster just beyond round numbers (Osler 2003, J. Finance 58)

rule.signal: quantum.research.b4.round_cross(close, 100.0): a 15-minute close crosses a multiple of $100 (previous close below, this close at or above -> LONG; mirror -> SHORT); the level not crossed by a close in the previous 20 bars
rule.horizon: 288 fifteen-minute bars (3 trading days); open at the horizon closes at that bar's close
rule.fills: the level, or the bar's open when it opened beyond it; a bar reaching both levels is a LOSS unless it opened beyond the target
rule.costs: harness.cost_pts (frozen engine model) at the decision bar, scaled
rule.paths: 15-minute bars of the validation partition only; trades whose horizon runs past it are not counted

primary_test.P1: success rate above the direction-matched random rate (every 15-minute close of the validation partition, long and short, same targets and scaling), one-sided z >= 1.645
primary_test.P2: mean net result per trade > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645

power_stated_in_advance: About 100 trades are expected (212 in the three development years). If the true edge equals the development estimate (+7.9 points over random), P1 passes about half the time; development estimates are inflated by selection, so the real chance is lower. A FAIL therefore means 'not confirmed', not 'proven absent'.
secondary_reported_not_decisive: by calendar half-year and by direction

decision.if_pass: Propose to the operator: the same rule, unchanged, on the sealed holdout (2024-07-01 -> 2025-12-31) opened once; only after that, a new forward shadow arm with its own freeze key. No live use before.
decision.if_fail: The round-number continuation lead is closed; recorded in research/trials.jsonl and the write-up. No re-run with changed parameters.
